sloka: तेजो वीर्यं बलं चौज उत्साहश्च महागुणः ।प्रदर्शनं च बुद्धिश्च स्मृतिश्च द्विगुणं तयोः ।। ६.५०.४० ।।।।
transliteration: tejo vīryaṁ balaṁ cauja utsāhaśca mahāguṇaḥ ।pradarśanaṁ ca buddhiśca smṛtiśca dviguṇaṁ tayoḥ ।। 6.50.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Their brilliance, prowess, daring courage, intelligence, memory, and great qualities got manifested many folds.
